title: Illustrating Hyperbolic Surfaces with Mesh Embeddings
summary: Hyperbolic geometry exhibits geometric phenomena, such as fast area growth, that are difficult to visualize faithfully in Euclidean space, and which standard models like the Poincaré disk can obscure. To bring hyperbolic geometry to life, we embed hyperbolic surfaces in Euclidean space by discretizing the surfaces into meshes, and minimizing a distortion energy so that the edge lengths in the embeddings match those in the hyperbolic plane.
